name: no_enemies_immortal
description: Enemies never drawn, both lift kinds visible, and the player never loses energy or dies.
evidence: obstruction is decided by what is present in the display, because $290B reads (display_pointer),Y and treats any byte that is neither zero nor $C0 as solid, so a sprite that is never drawn cannot block the player
four separate routines draw moving sprites: $23BF for second-class entities, $3532 for indexed entities, $2EAA for indexed pairs and $3453 for indexed XOR graphics
xor_draw_player_two_parts at $2A89 draws the player and is deliberately left alone
the damage routine has two entries: $2B88 sets up and falls through, and $2B8F is a separate lifted function entry, so patching only $2B88 leaves callers entering lower down unaffected
$2B8F decrements the energy count at $3B, and $2B93 loads 1 into the death flag at $62 when that decrement reaches zero
replacing the decrement with LDA #$01 leaves the Z flag clear so the guarding BNE always skips the death store, and $2630 begins TYA/PHA/LDA $3B so clobbering A is safe
loading 0 rather than 1 before the death store makes it harmless even if some path reaches it, which covers the case where a caller enters below the decrement
qualifications: the indexed entity draw at $3532 draws the enemy robots: re-enabling it made them visible again, so it is suppressed. The indexed pair draw at $2EAA is left enabled as the next candidate for the horizontally moving lifts

the lift/hazard draw at $23C7 is deliberately left enabled: update_lift_or_hazard_by_class routes lifts to apply_moving_entity_to_player, the push that carries the player. Disabling it alone was reported to leave the other visible enemies unchanged

the indexed entity draw at $3532 is left enabled because those are the only entities with a horizontal mover: advance_indexed_entity_horizontal_position steps $123A and carries the $47/$48 pointer 8 bytes with it, while the second class has only a vertical mover. The player reported vertical lifts visible and horizontal ones missing, which matches that split
an earlier attempt disabled only $23BF and the player reported no visible change, which is what identifies the visible enemies as belonging to one of the other three systems
this suppresses all four rather than identifying which, so scenery or objects animated through the same routines will also disappear
drawing and erasing are the same XOR call, so any sprite already on screen when this takes effect is never erased; entities are drawn fresh on room entry so a clean start should be unaffected
the entities still exist and still move, and anything reading their coordinates rather than the display still sees them
$2732 also writes the death flag, inside the control poller and reached by a key nothing has ever pressed, so it is left alone
damage still plays its sound and redraws the bar, so contact stays visible and audible; only the cost is removed
enemies remain drawn and solid: obstruction by an enemy is not what this changes
the f2 and f3 INKEY numbers are derived rather than proved by play
